composites.name: sego_crossparadigm
composites.description: Sego 2022 influenza blueprint compiled onto a mechanics backend (cpm|vertex|munk): the shared field/rules/ODE/recruitment mechanism plus the one backend-specific mechanics node.

blueprint.description: backend-neutral blueprint: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict (Blueprint Studio sends inline YAML)

video_out.description: if set, record a spatial-playback video to reports/assets/_studio_runs/<video_out>.html (Blueprint Studio)

composites.name: sego_crossparadigm_large
composites.description: Scaled-up Sego 2022 influenza preset: a biology-preserving ~2.4x linear scale-up of 'sego_crossparadigm' (120x120 patch, 15x15 ~225-cell epithelial block) -- a bigger tissue, the SAME field/rules/ODE/recruitment mechanism. A heavier starting point to run from in the Blueprint Studio.

blueprint.description: backend-neutral blueprint: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict (defaults to the scaled-up Sego preset)

video_out.description: if set, record a spatial-playback video to reports/assets/_studio_runs/<video_out>.html (Blueprint Studio)

composites.name: blueprint_pipeline
composites.description: Backend-neutral blueprint compiled onto a mechanics backend (cpm|vertex|munk): fields/rules/ODE/immune mechanism, plus an optional per-cell subcellular layer arbitrated into the mechanics inputs by the actuation merge.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict (v1 flat or v2 sectioned)

video_out.description: if set, record a spatial-playback video to reports/assets/_studio_runs/<video_out>.html

composites.name: grammar_rules_demo
composites.description: Stage-2 demo: a grammar-shaped blueprint compiled onto a mechanics backend (cpm|vertex|munk) with viva-grammar's BlueprintGrammarProcess swapped into the rules slot in place of RulesProcess — the published cell-behavior grammar (pressure/contact -> transform/divide/die) driving the real ABM.

composites.name: bounded_particles
composites.description: Smoldyn particle sims confined inside tyssue cells: each vertex cell is a moving polygon with its own reflective Smoldyn sim (A+B<->C); molecules split into daughters on division. Writes a cell-coloured overlay to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict

backend.description: multicellular substrate the particles are bounded by: 'cpm', 'vertex', or 'munk'

divide_every.description: divide one cell every N steps (0 = never)

composites.name: scene_model
composites.description: A scene of cells, each bound by type to a model in its own formalism (SBML-ODE, Smoldyn particles, MaBoSS Boolean) sharing one extracellular field.

composites.name: coupled_fate_oscillator
composites.description: One cell, two coupled sub-cellular sims: an SBML-ODE metabolism and a MaBoSS Boolean fate network form a metabolism↔fate feedback oscillator (C builds → pins high_C → divide fires → division resets metabolism → repeat). Runs a small tissue of these coupled cells.

n_cells.description: number of coupled cells in the tissue

composites.name: coupled_particle_catalysis
composites.description: One cell, two coupled sub-cellular sims: a Smoldyn particle population (A+B→C, confined to the cell polygon) catalyses an SBML-ODE reaction S→P — the live particle C count sets the ODE rate constant each step (mode B), so P accumulates faster as the particle population builds. Runs a small tissue of these coupled cells.

n_cells.description: number of coupled cells in the tissue

composites.name: coupled_triple_cell
composites.description: One cell running ALL THREE sub-cellular formalisms, coupled by all three modes: a Smoldyn particle population catalyses an SBML-ODE metabolism (mode B), whose metabolite C pins a MaBoSS fate input (mode A), whose 'divide' output resets the metabolism (mode C). Particles → metabolism → fate → division, in a single cell.

n_cells.description: number of triple-coupled cells in the tissue

composites.name: fateful_tissue
composites.description: The full-stack crown: a dividing tyssue where each cell runs a Smoldyn particle sim (split on division) AND an ODE metabolism whose metabolite pins a MaBoSS fate network — and the fate network's 'divide' output drives the tissue division. Biology decides when the tissue divides. Writes a fate-coloured flipbook + GIF to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict

c_threshold.description: metabolite C level that pins the fate 'high_C' input

max_divisions_per_step.description: cap on fate-driven divisions per step (tissue stability)

composites.name: tri_coupled
composites.description: All three mechanics paradigms on one shared cell set, coupled into a consensus: CPM (voxel) owns area, vertex (polygon) owns shape, munk (center-based disc) owns position. Writes an overlay of all three per cell to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict

cpm_temp.description: CPM Metropolis temperature (lower = crisper shape match)

composites.name: divergence_compare
composites.description: One blueprint run four ways from the same init: CPM, vertex and center-based each ALONE (top row) vs the tri-coupled consensus (bottom row), as a 3x2 animation showing how the paradigms diverge. Writes a flipbook + GIF to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict

render_every.description: keep only every Nth step in the gif (long runs stay small)

composites.name: fateful_consensus
composites.description: Grand unification: a tri-coupled consensus tissue (CPM owns area, vertex owns shape, munk owns position) where every cell runs an SBML-ODE metabolism whose metabolite pins a MaBoSS fate network — and each cell's CPM AREA sets its metabolic rate, so tissue mechanics drives sub-cellular fate. Three tissue + two sub-cellular simulators in one composite; writes a fate-coloured consensus flipbook to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict

composites.name: particle_consensus
composites.description: Smoldyn particles confined inside a tri-coupled consensus tissue: each cell runs an A+B<->C particle sim bounded by a boundary three tissue simulators agree on (vertex shape, munk-consensus position, CPM area). Writes a flipbook to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

blueprint.description: a path to a YAML file, inline YAML text, or a dict

composites.name: heterotypic_regions
composites.description: Two tissue types, two physics: a vertex-simulated epithelium (sheet) sitting on a center-based munk mesenchyme (loose cells), coupled at their interface — the epithelium's basal edge is a reflective floor the mesenchyme presses up against. Writes a flipbook to reports/assets/<overlay_out>.html.

composites.name: hypoxia_motility
composites.description: Paper's oxygen->motility tumor model: grammar rules on a minimal oxygen-field + point-agent reference substrate (transient post-hypoxic migration).

n_cells.description: Initial tumor cells seeded in a disk.

seed_radius.description: Radius (µm) of the initial tumor disk.

interval.description: Composite tick (min); rules use per-time rates.

uptake.description: Per-cell oxygen uptake (controls core hypoxia / gradient).

reoxygenation_time.description: Minute at which uptake is relieved (reoxygenation).

composites.name: attachment
composites.description: Cells settling/attaching on a surface.

composites.name: bending_pressure
composites.description: Bending-pressure rod-like cells.

composites.name: biofilm
composites.description: Growing biofilm with EPS secretion + pressure dynamics.

composites.name: chemotaxis
composites.description: Run/tumble chemotaxis up a static 2D ligand gradient.

composites.name: daughter_machine
composites.description: Daughter-machine geometry: tracking daughter cells.

composites.name: glucose_growth
composites.description: Glucose-driven growth and division.

composites.name: inclusion_bodies
composites.description: Inclusion-body accumulation across a growing colony.

composites.name: mother_machine
composites.description: Mother-machine geometry: single-channel cell trapping.

composites.name: quorum_sensing
composites.description: Quorum-sensing autoinducer feedback in a growing colony.
